label: CONTINUE THE PROJECT
title:

say: Continue the same project as it evolves. The conversation keeps requested changes, completed work, acceptance, and publication together.

label: FOLLOW THE WORK
title:

behind the result.
say: Open a run to inspect its execution and recorded checks. Review what happened, including the work behind the delivered files.

label: OPEN THE DELIVERABLES
title:

inspect and keep.
say: Open the delivered files, preview the result, and keep the source. The output remains available beyond the conversation.

label: REVIEW / ACCEPT / PUBLISH
title:

to publication.
say: In Attica, the latest repair is accepted, sent to GitHub, and put online. Each step stays visible in the project.
